name: 81122 · Bayfield, CO
findings: ZIP 81122 (Bayfield) has 22 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (23%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 81122 (Bayfield) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
